scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @taptalk/shared && npm run build --workspace @taptalk/api && npm run build --workspace @taptalk/web
scripts.build:production: npm run clean:production && npm run build:production --workspace @taptalk/shared && npm run build:production --workspace @taptalk/api && npm run build --workspace @taptalk/web && npm run verify:production
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @taptalk/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @taptalk/web && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:shared && npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.base.json .prettierrc.json eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts e2e apps packages scripts .github/workflows/ci.yml
